Section 910.2, Code 2026, is amended by adding 1 the following new subsection: 2 NEW SUBSECTION . 3. Notwithstanding any other statute 3 or rule of law, with the consent of the defendant and the 4 prosecuting attorney, the court may order as part of the 5 dismissal of a public offense that the defendant pay pecuniary 6 damages to the victim, category “B” restitution, which shall 7 include court costs, and prosecution costs under section 8 815.13. 9 EXPLANATION 10 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 11 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 12 This bill relates to the payment of pecuniary damages, 13 restitution, and prosecution costs. 14 The bill provides that notwithstanding any other statute 15 or rule of law, with the consent of the defendant and the 16 prosecuting attorney, the court may order as part of the 17 dismissal of a public offense that the defendant pay pecuniary 18 damages to the victim, category “B” restitution, which shall 19 include court costs, and prosecution costs. 20 -1- LSB 6056YC (2) 91 as/js 1/ 1
